verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no marketplace or catalog of ready-made scrapers that a developer could browse and run. ScrapingBee does offer a fixed set of first-party dedicated APIs (Google, Amazon, Walmart, YouTube) that return structured data without building a scraper. Those are a related but different feature, not a scraper marketplace, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a ready-made scraper from a marketplace instead of building one from scratch
